shared_elements: upright monolithic block bearing carved low-relief motifs
row of repeated motifs across the upper part of the surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright blocks bearing shallow, schematic relief motifs, and both include discs/rings and a repeated row of similar shapes across the top zone, which is the most concrete correspondence. However, A depicts a menagerie of recognisable creatures (bird in profile, snake, quadrupeds) in horizontal registers beneath the arch-like row, while B is an anthropomorphic figure with a modelled face whose torso carries only abstract curved and circular signs, so the subject matter is fundamentally different.
